churn_resistance.rationale: Data access, types and configuration are centralized so a framework upgrade would touch only the root shell, router and vite config — very good isolation. The deductions are duplicated search-param default logic, the notFound union/conditional-head pattern copy-pasted across four routes, and a few dead helpers.

findings.issue: Missing resources are modelled as a {notFound:true} discriminator returned from the loader and re-handled manually in all four detail routes (moves/abilities/pokemon/types.$name.tsx:20,20,52,20), bypassing the router's current notFound()/notFoundComponent API; pages respond 200 instead of 404 and the pattern is duplicated in four page types and four head() conditionals.
findings.suggestion: Have the loaders (or a small wrapper around the server fns) throw notFound() and declare notFoundComponent on the root route; delete the notFound unions and per-route NotFoundPage branches.

findings.issue: fetch() is issued with no AbortSignal/timeout; a slow upstream API stalls an SSR request indefinitely and the pending promise stays memoized in the module-level cache (only rejections evict).
findings.suggestion: Pass AbortSignal.timeout(…) (or a per-request signal) to fetch and evict the cache entry on abort as well.

findings.issue: The 'strip empty/default search params' rule is implemented three times (validateSearch at :17, update at :47, linkSearch at :73), so a change to the param set must be made in three places.
findings.suggestion: Extract a single normalizeSearch(params) helper and use navigate's functional search form ((prev) => next) for pagination/filter updates.

findings.issue: trackable, formatHeight, formatWeight and compareText are exported with no call sites — dead code that also makes data.server.ts inline its own height/weight/dash formatting (app/src/lib/data.server.ts:535-536).
findings.suggestion: Delete the unused helpers or use them from data.server.ts so the formatting rules live in one place.

findings.issue: nitro is pinned to an exact prerelease version (3.0.261029-rc); the build server is on a moving RC track with no range, so updates are manual bumps.
findings.suggestion: Keep the requirement but follow the framework examples' caret prerelease range (^3.0.x-rc) so patch releases flow, and revisit when Nitro 3 goes stable.

findings.issue: idFromUrl extracts the ID with a hand-rolled regex over API URL strings rather than the URL API.
findings.suggestion: Use Number(new URL(url).pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean).at(-1)) (with a null check) so the parsing intent is explicit and robust to query strings.

findings.issue: No defaultErrorComponent/defaultNotFoundComponent (and no per-route errorComponent): a server-fn or upstream API error bubbles to the router's bare default boundary instead of a branded error page.
findings.suggestion: Declare defaultErrorComponent and defaultNotFoundComponent on createRouter, which also pairs with the notFound() migration.

findings.issue: Every server-fn .validator() is an identity cast ((data: T) => data), so URL-derived inputs (q/type/generation/page, game, name) are typed but not actually validated on the server boundary.
findings.suggestion: Use a tiny schema (valibot/zod or a hand-written guard) in the validators, or drop the validator where input is already normalized by validateSearch.

findings.issue: getHomeData fans out one /pokemon/<id> fetch per card (48 parallel requests per page before the cache warms) rather than any batching or a lighter source of per-species types.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable given the in-memory cache, but consider caching the derived type-by-species map once the species list is fetched to avoid the per-request fan-out.

summary: This is a genuinely current TanStack Start app: the Nitro Vite plugin setup, getRouter() factory, HeadContent/Scripts shell, and canonical .validator() server functions all match the post-1.169-stable docs, with zero deprecated RC APIs and a minimal four-runtime-dependency footprint. Data access is cleanly isolated behind one module with shared view-model types, so framework upgrades would touch few files. The main forward-looking gaps are the hand-rolled notFound-in-loader-data pattern instead of the router's notFound()/notFoundComponent API (no 404s, duplicated across four routes), fetches with no timeout, and some copy-pasted search-param and formatting logic that will drift over time.

apis.replacement: Should be used instead of the {notFound:true} loader-data union so the router renders the not-found UI and can respond 404
